skill.name: write-natural
skill.description: Create, revise, humanize, translate, and audit natural, evidence-led Persian and English writing. Use for anti-slop editing, detector-aware revision, academic/scientific papers and theses, web/SEO articles, product descriptions, landing pages, copywriting, sales, email, reports, essays, and creative prose. Preserve facts, qualifications, author voice, and purpose while removing generic AI phrasing. Trigger on natural writing, humanize, AI tells, anti-slop, AI detector flags, نگارش، نویسندگی، ضد اسلپ، انسانی‌سازی، متن فارسی، مقاله، پایان‌نامه، سئو، کپی‌رایتینگ، و ضد تشخیص. Detector-aware means informed editing and honest evaluation, never guaranteed undetectability.
skill.summary: Draft, revise, and translate Persian and English prose while preserving evidence, author voice, and factual qualifications.
skill.author: sinadwm1

content.user_title: Write Natural Persian and English Prose
content.value_statement: Fluent drafts can contain generic phrasing, altered claims, or an unsuitable voice. This skill guides evidence-led writing and faithful revision in Persian and English.
actual_capabilities: Draft, revise, outline, critique, and translate Persian and English text using language and genre references.
Preserve names, numbers, citations, uncertainty, terminology, and author voice during revision.
Identify generic framing, inflated claims, repetition, and unsuitable register without imposing universal word bans.
Guide academic, web, SEO, product, sales, and creative writing from supplied evidence.
Run optional offline diagnostics for selected stock phrases, Persian spacing, Arabic letter forms, and repeated text.
Compare revisions for changed quantities, units, ranges, protected spans, selected qualifiers, and explicit content contracts.
limitations: Heuristic diagnostics cannot verify facts, prove semantic equivalence, detect plagiarism, or determine authorship.
The skill cannot guarantee detector outcomes, publication acceptance, SEO rankings, or sales improvements.
Optional scripts require Python 3.9 or later; installation and linked-reference access depend on the host.
The package is not a document renderer or a complete Markdown parser; formatted RTL output requires separate tooling.

use_cases.title: Preserve scientific qualifications
use_cases.description: Revise abstracts or thesis passages while retaining sample limits, uncertainty, quantities, citations, and the distinction between association and causation.

use_cases.title: Write evidence-based product pages
use_cases.description: Turn supplied product facts into clear web or sales copy without invented testimonials, superiority claims, or performance metrics.

use_cases.title: Adapt bilingual editorial content
use_cases.description: Translate or edit Persian and English passages while preserving voice, technical terms, quotations, identifiers, and appropriate formality.

prompt_templates.title: Revise one paragraph
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $write-natural to revise this paragraph for [audience]. Remove generic setup and repetition. Preserve facts and uncertainty. Add nothing unsupported. Text: [paragraph].

prompt_templates.title: Translate with protected terms
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $write-natural to translate [passage] into [Persian or English] for [audience]. Keep [terms], numbers, citations, quotations, and URLs unchanged. Match [register].

prompt_templates.title: Draft from evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $write-natural in source-led mode for [deliverable]. Use only [sources]. Separate observations from interpretation. Preserve qualifications and link material claims to support. Identify missing evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Audit revision integrity
prompt_templates.prompt: Use $write-natural to compare [original] with [revision]. Protect [exact strings] and require [terms]. Review quantities, citations, negation, scope, and voice. Use offline diagnostics if available. Explain limitations.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine content contracts with revision review

output_examples.input: Revise this scientific statement without strengthening it: In this small sample, the intervention may have reduced errors.
output_examples.output: The intervention may have reduced errors in this small sample.

output_examples.input: Write product copy using only these fictional facts: three USB ports and a two-year warranty. Do not invent performance claims.
output_examples.output: The product has three USB ports and a two-year warranty.

output_examples.input: Compare an original stating that a dose may be 10 mg with a revision stating that the dose is 15 mg.
output: The quantity changed from 10 mg to 15 mg.
The revision removed the uncertainty expressed by may.
Review both changes against the source before accepting the revision.

best_practices: Provide the audience, genre, language, edit scope, supporting evidence, and a relevant voice sample.
Identify protected names, figures, citations, qualifications, and exact wording before substantial revision.
Review diagnostic findings in context and compare the final draft with its sources.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a clean diagnostic report as proof of factual accuracy, equivalent meaning, or human authorship.
Do not invent personal experiences, citations, testimonials, or measurements to make prose more specific.
Do not upload confidential drafts or use external detectors without authorization.

faq.question: Which languages does this skill support?
faq.answer: It provides Persian and English writing guidance, including register, terminology, orthography, and mixed-language content.

faq.question: Does it guarantee that AI detectors will not flag a text?
faq.answer: No. It improves prose and interprets supplied detector results within their limits. It does not guarantee undetectability or establish human authorship.

faq.question: Does ordinary editing require Python or an online service?
faq.answer: No. The writing instructions need neither. Optional offline diagnostics require Python 3.9 or later and use only the standard library.

faq.question: What do the diagnostic scripts check?
faq.answer: They flag selected phrases, Persian orthography, repetition, changed quantities, protected spans, and certain qualifiers. Findings require contextual review.

faq.question: Can it verify sources and factual accuracy?
faq.answer: It guides claim-to-source review but cannot certify facts. Verification still requires actual evidence and access to the relevant source material.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The package declares support for these tools. Installation varies by host; keep the core and linked references together and verify reference access.
